title: CGO Webview Bindings
summary: This module provides CGO (C-Go) bindings that enable the Go application to interact with the embedded webview. It facilitates dispatching events, binding Go functions to JavaScript, and unbinding them.

nodes.label: Dispatch Webview Call
nodes.title: Dispatch Webview Call
nodes.description: Dispatches a function call or event from the Go runtime to the underlying webview instance, executing a JavaScript function asynchronously.

nodes.label: Bind Go Function to Webview
nodes.title: Bind Go Function
nodes.description: Establishes a binding between a Go function and a JavaScript function within the webview, allowing JavaScript to invoke Go code.

nodes.label: Unbind Webview Function
nodes.title: Unbind Webview Function
nodes.description: Removes a previously established binding between a Go function and a JavaScript function in the webview, preventing further invocations.

nodes.label: Webview Instance
nodes.title: Underlying Webview
nodes.description: The core webview component (e.g., WebKit, Edge, Webview2) that renders web content and interacts with native code.

nodes.label: Go Application Runtime
nodes.title: Go Application
nodes.description: The Go application runtime that utilizes these CGO bindings to control and interact with the embedded webview.

groups.label: CGO Webview API
groups.title: CGO Webview API
groups.description: Core CGO functions for managing interactions between the Go application and the embedded webview.
